title: Kokum Sherbet
description: A cooling coastal Maharashtrian drink of soaked kokum with sugar, roasted cumin and black salt, served chilled.
steps: Rinse the kokum rinds and soak them in 200 ml of warm water for 30 minutes.
Squeeze and crush the kokum in the water to release the deep pink juice, then strain and discard the rinds.
Stir in the sugar until it dissolves completely.
Add the roasted cumin powder, black salt and the remaining cold water.
Chill well and serve over ice.
